findings.title: Stored nested request format changes are accepted
findings.trigger: After a valid freeze, alter only stored Receipt.Request.Format to an unknown value, then request status or replay using the original request digest.
findings.evidence: Deserialize<Receipt> does not execute the top-level ActualSourceFreezeRequest Format validation. System.Text.Json ignores a changed getter-only nested Format value, and recomputed request digest uses the constant getter.
findings.impact: A modified stored receipt can pass the exact receipt verification contract.
findings.suggestion: For the tool-generated receipt, require ordinal equality between the original stored JSON and JsonSerializer.Serialize(deserializedReceipt), or explicitly validate the nested raw Request.Format before accepting the receipt.
findings.reproduction: Code-path review only; no SQL or tests executed by reviewer.

resolution.fix: Before receipt acceptance, the stored tool-generated JSON must equal JsonSerializer.Serialize(receipt) using StringComparison.Ordinal. Changed getter-only nested Format values can no longer be silently normalized.
testCoverage: Modified nested receipt format is rejected by status and replay.
Rejected operations preserve Frozen state and a single Audit row.
Restoring the valid receipt allows replay and status at generation 1.

confirmed: Public rehearsal validation remains intact; actual receipt marker blocks legacy entries, including rehearsal-named catalogs.
Public inspector remains read-only after shared transaction extraction.
Actual source identity, original request, prior scope, frozen scope, and generation/run are bound.
First freeze keeps application/table locks, guard DDL, control/audit, and receipt in one caller-owned SQL transaction.
Normalization removes only verified owned guards and exact owned public denies; pre-change baselines use the matched observation hashes.
CLI request file hashes cover the same bytes that are parsed, and explicit unknown/duplicate JSON checks are present.
Actual reopen and seal are deliberately refused; complete write isolation, approval verification, target verification, and recovery integration remain false.
limitations: No database, build, test, process, or Git write operations were executed by this reviewer.
Parent-reported synthetic tests are not actual environment activation evidence.
Cross-source drain, target/routing recovery coordination, privileged writers, and actual activation are intentionally outside this component and remain unfinished.
No claim that the entire C04A objective is complete.
